Name: Clint's Cozy Machine Shop
Author: xxmissxmariexx
Description:
✨ Clint’s Cozy Machine Shop ✨
🌸 A simple Blacksmith shop expansion for Stardew Valley 🌸

Tired of crafting the same machines over and over again?
Want an easier way to stock up on artisan equipment without constantly hunting for materials?

Clint’s Cozy Machine Shop adds a selection of useful machines and bars directly to Clint’s Blacksmith shop, making artisan production smoother, easier, and more convenient.

Now Clint sells more than just tool upgrades and ore — he can help you build the cozy, productive farm of your dreams. 🌻

🌟 What This Mod Adds

This mod adds the following items to Clint’s Blacksmith shop:

🌼 Artisan & Farm Machines
Keg
Preserves Jar
Dehydrator
Bee House
Mayonnaise Machine
Cheese Press
Oil Maker
Loom
Fish Smoker
Crystalarium

✨ Bars & Resources
Copper Bar
Iron Bar
Gold Bar
Iridium Bar

🌷 Why Use This Mod?

This is a simple convenience shop edit for players who want easier access to major production machines and core crafting resources.

Perfect for:

Cozy farm playthroughs
Artisan-heavy farms
Players who love decorating and producing goods
Faster progression
Relaxed or casual saves
Modded farms with lots of production needs

🌻 Requirements
SMAPI
Content Patcher

🌸 Installation
Download the mod.
Unzip the folder.
Place the folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
Launch the game through SMAPI.
Visit Clint’s Blacksmith shop.

✨ Compatibility

This mod edits Clint’s shop using Content Patcher and does not replace any vanilla files.

It should be compatible with most mods unless another mod heavily edits the same Blacksmith shop inventory.

🚫 Permissions / Reupload Policy

Please do not reupload, redistribute, repost, or include this mod in any other mod pack, website, collection, or download page without my explicit permission.

This mod is intended to be downloaded only from my official upload page.

You may use this mod for personal gameplay, but please do not claim it as your own, edit and reupload it, or upload it anywhere else.

🌼 Enjoy!

Build your dream farm, fill your sheds with machines, and let Clint handle the hard part. ✨
